notes.title: The Collar Release Notes - v2.0.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=c4DmPLkCW4c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Update 1[/h1]
I am very excited to bring you Update 1 or v2.0.0 of The Collar. I have worked hard to make sure I deliver a quality game that keeps pushing this experience further each time. I hope everyone enjoys all the additions, new areas to find surprises, new ways to eliminate other players, and some bug fixes sprinkled in. My roadmap is big and long and this is the start of a long journey. I will keep bringing even more laughter and fun to you and your foes! Hope to see you in an experiment!

~The Collar is bigger and better.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Players[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allow free look when long interacting, healing bleeds, and being trapped
[*] Players can now randomly fall on slippery surfaces like ice and polished floors
[list][*] Added a squeaky floor sound when running on the freshly polished floors that are slippery
[*] Updated slippery surfaces friction to feel more real
[*] Fixed squeaky floor sound effect to be more realistic[/list][*] Players can now be knocked down when being hit hard enough in the head, in the body with certain weapons, and weapon sweeps to the legs
[*] Players who perform a knock down hit use more stamina and as a player is getting up they will take less damage
[*] Players have red blood and Bots have black blood
[list][*] Characters handle different color blood on player splatter
[*] Weapons handle different color blood on weapon splatter
[*] Fixed an issue with the blood color not changing for characters and their blood splatters across all players[/list][/list][h2]Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Weapon: Energy Drink and a Drink Machine for vending[/b]
[i]The energy drink machines will allow players to vend an energy drink. Each energy drink machine can dispense a limited number of energy drinks. This energy drink is a useful weapon that hits very hard. The energy drink has a limited number of hits before it will explode so be careful throwing and swinging it around. The energy drink machines can be found on The Parking Garage and The Train Station.[/i]
[*] Added new achievements for the new weapons
[*] Added new stats for the the new weapons
[*] Branches and energy drinks are both breakable weapons and are limited use
[/list][h2]Environment Weapons[/h2]
[i]Each environment weapon has different properties and cause damage in different ways. The damage is very hurtful to any player who gets caught in the damage wake from low stamina, the inability to run, slow limping, and even bleeding. These can be very immobilizing so be careful or be very clever in their use as some are one time use and others can be used multiple times. When close, these will glow white so players know they are able to interact with them.[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]The Bear Trap[/b]
[i]The bear trap has multiple states, unset, set, trapped, and back to unset. Setting a trap is as easy as finding one, and setting it. Once any player, that includes the player who set the trap, hits a set trap, they will be trapped until they release themselves. They will be bleeding and the players body will have difficulty moving. Both of which will need to be remedied. Once a trap is released, after a random amount of time, it can be reset for the next the victim. Set bear traps can be sprung with any weapon thrown at it. The bear traps are randomly scattered on The Winter Forest.[/i]
[*] [b]The Fire Extinguisher[/b]
[i]Fire extinguishers can be hit with a axe, baseball bat, or crowbar causing the tank to rupture. This will cause a dangerously cold gas to be released very rapidly into the surrounding air causing frost bite on players skin and in their lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The fire extinguishers can be found on The Parking Garage and The Warehouse.[/i]
[*] [b]The Gas Tank & The Radioactive Oxygen Tank[/b]
[i]These tanks have a loose release valve and hitting them or throwing something hard at them will cause the valve to break. Once broken the tank will release a noxious gas into the air around them for a time. It is very difficult to breath causing coughing and damage to the lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The gas tanks can be found on The Abandoned Factory. The radioactive oxygen tanks can be found on The Waste Pit.[/i]
[*] [b]The Generator and Electrified Metal[/b]
[i]The generators have a sensitive safety fuse which can be tripped very easily with something thrown at them. Once they are tripped, all the lights turn off and most metal gets an electric arc that causes it to be electrified. The hum of electric current will be heard whilst it is dangerous and will cause a nasty electric shock and burn if touched. If electrocuted it takes time for the players body to recover. After the safety fuse resets, it will take time for the lights to come back on and for the safety fuse to be able to be disrupted again. The generators can be found on The Industrial Park.[/i]
[*] Added white glow on environment weapons within a radius so players know they can interact with them
[*] Added stamina and movement disabilities when hurt by environment weapons[/list][h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] CFT will now be randomly positioned on the level at the start of each level
[*] Fixed an issue with the CFT not be positioned correctly for all players after random placing it at the start of a level
[/list]
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[h2]Players[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated collar lighting brightness down by 120% to not have over-glow and bloom blowout across all levels
[*] Updated weapon swing speed to be 25% faster when stamina is above 25%
[*] Updated vocal sound when you slip and fall
[*] Updated crouching to happen much quicker
[*] Updated long interaction to happen more quickly now
[*] Updated to make player face interactable item before using it
[*] Updated weapon throwing to make it more accurate
[/list][h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated destructible system for performance and future expansions
[*] Updated destruction system to give player damage, but also allow different types of damage inflicted upon the destructible item
[*] Updated environment triggers to be able to move after playing
[*] Updated the metal gates to be consistent across each level
[*] Updated the CFT to have more options for future expansions
[*] Updated skies for more natural star shine when sun is setting or rising
[/list][h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the number of audio channels from 32 to 64
[/list][h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated message after clicking the "Back to waiting room" button so it is not just hanging there before the load starts
[*] Updated Overall stats layout and look
[*] Updated How To Play overall
[*] Updated How To Play on environment weapons to be more clear
[*] Updated map images with the new map light builds
[*] Updated translations
[*] Updated credits including the timing on the initial scroll
[*] Updated default input to be set to mouse and keyboard
[*] Updated Beta games so the stats do overwrite the release stats
[*] Updated Beta games so no achievements get calculated
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Players[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that played animation when player could not move
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to crouch, jump, or attack whilst doing other actions
[*] Fixed an issue with the turn animation making it smoother and less stuttery

[*] Fixed an issue causing the last attacker to not get the kill if player dies from falling or bleeding
[*] Fixed an issue when everyone dies, regardless of how, stats are given and reported correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with collisions not being consistent across all players
[*] Fixed an issue where players would keep taking damage after the round was over[/list][h2]Weapons[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue that was destroying the projectiles early
[*] Fixed an issue when a breakable weapon breaks that would not drop broken weapon[/list][h2]Environment Weapons[/h2]

[/list][h2]UI[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue causing the round stats to report death by melee even when still alive
[*] Fixed an issue with overall results UI and made it more clear
[*] Fixed an issue with the Round stats UI
[*] Fixed an issue with padding on the UI stats
[*] Fixed an issue with the save game file
[/list]
[h1]Bots[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bots now evade attacks better which includes dodging and crouching (self-learned skilled)
[*] Bots now climb on any climbable (self-learned skilled)
[/list][h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated melee attack range
[*] Updated bots when running away so they are not quite so dumb
[*] Removed bots climbing links as they are no longer needed
[/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause bots to not run away if hit too many times and thus failing to protect themselves
[*] Fixed an issue with bots causing errors with no post processing materials
[/list]
[h1]Maps[/h1]
[h2]New Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The Cemetery[/b]
[i]The cold rain floods a somber place with its cool water and heart crackling thunder. The world around you is soaked with fear and loss. Each tomb represents one or more loses, standing above the ground for all to see. The cool breeze riddles through your wetness and sends a shiver up your spine…or perhaps it is just the dead. Find yourself weaving in and out of those lost before you in a maze of hide-n-seek. Careful though as you run and hide, there may be someone or something waiting for you. Do you find your way out? Or did you find your own tomb?[/i]
[*] [b]The Parking Garage[/b]
[i]The sun glimpses the edge of that moment of calm and serenity before the hustle and bustle fills the air of sound and smell of the city, the birds, and the people, starting to wake from their slumber. Protected by the solid walls of drab concrete and steel, sits the cars as the vessels for destinations from the journeys to come. As the cars sit waiting, you are not as lucky, as waiting may end your journey and there are levels of opportunity all around you. As you go up and down, each level provides a new opportunity. Does it end with you on top? Or do these walls park you in your final destination.[/i]
[*] [b]The Train Station[/b]
[i]The evening has descended onto the world. As the need to be able to take more of you to those far off places grows, a new station blossoms. Other operational stations rumble all around, as the darkness overtakes this one for the last time with the glow of its awaiting maiden voyage breaking through. Three trains prepared for the new adventures await in this uneasy calm. Three sleeping giants ready to burst into the world. Adventure is just the beginning for you, however, who have found this calm. And if not careful, you shall find a calm that lasts for eternity.[/i][/list][h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: New Year, New Update
notes.content:
New year. New Update. That is right folks the time is at hand! Update 1 is right around the corner and I am excited to share a PREVIEW of what is coming. New maps. New environment weapons to spice up game play. New weapons. Plus many, many fixes and updates to keep this game moving forward! Not everything is listed here (you will have to wait for the release notes) but this gives you a taste of some of the big changes.

I look forward to getting to play and laugh with as many of you as I can! You are all so amazing and I cannot thank you enough for being a part of this awesome community we have created. I am on the cusp of release so keep your eyes peeled!

~The Collar is preparing to kill you in new ways.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646934/70c19dc7c4b1c269b999c94c8cddcd28a371e111.png[/img]
[b]The Cemetery[/b]
The cold rain floods a somber place with its cool water and heart crackling thunder. The world around you is soaked with fear and loss. Each tomb represents one or more loses, standing above the ground for all to see. The cool breeze riddles through your wetness and sends a shiver up your spine…or perhaps it is just the dead. Find yourself weaving in and out of those lost before you in a maze of hide-n-seek. Careful though as you run and hide, there may be someone or something waiting for you. Do you find your way out? Or did you find your own tomb?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646934/9e919f4fa0de007910145d66fa9e0d2e2fdc7947.png[/img]
[b]The Parking Garage[/b]
The sun glimpses the edge of that moment of calm and serenity before the hustle and bustle fills the air of sound and smell of the city, the birds, and the people, starting to wake from their slumber. Protected by the solid walls of drab concrete and steel, sits the cars as the vessels for destinations from the journeys to come. As the cars sit waiting, you are not as lucky, as waiting may end your journey and there are levels of opportunity all around you. As you go up and down, each level provides a new opportunity. Does it end with you on top? Or do these walls park you in your final destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646934/db3fed599462cf3a61349061fe59ecebe91f6378.png[/img]
[b]The Train Station[/b]
The evening has descended onto the world. As the need to be able to take more of you to those far off places grows, a new station blossoms. Other operational stations rumble all around, as the darkness overtakes this one for the last time with the glow of its awaiting maiden voyage breaking through. Three trains prepared for the new adventures await in this uneasy calm. Three sleeping giants ready to burst into the world. Adventure is just the beginning for you, however, who have found this calm. And if not careful, you shall find a calm that lasts for eternity.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44646934/7ec1d8b6184bd8f6caf26a7eeb559c15236fd87c.png[/img]
[b]Environment Weapons[/b]
When close, these will glow white so players know they are able to interact with them. Each environment weapon has different properties and cause damage in different ways. The damage is very hurtful to any player who gets caught in the damage wake from low stamina, the inability to run, slow limping, and even bleeding. These can be very immobilizing so be careful or be very clever in their use as some are one time use and others can be used multiple times.

[b]The Bear Trap[/b]
The bear trap has multiple states, unset, set, trapped, and back to unset. Setting a trap is as easy as finding one, and setting it. Once any player, that includes the player who set the trap, hits a set trap, they will be trapped until they release themselves. They will be bleeding and the players body will have difficulty moving. Both of which will need to be remedied. Once a trap is released, after a random amount of time, it can be reset for the next the victim. Set bear traps can be sprung with any weapon thrown at it. The bear traps are randomly scattered on The Winter Forest.

[b]The Fire Extinguisher[/b]
Fire extinguishers can be hit with a axe, baseball bat, or crowbar causing the tank to rupture. This will cause a dangerously cold gas to be released very rapidly into the surrounding air causing frost bite on players skin and in their lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The fire extinguishers can be found on The Parking Garage and The Warehouse.

[b]The Gas Tank & The Radioactive Oxygen Tank[/b]
These tanks have a loose release valve and hitting them or throwing something hard at them will cause the valve to break. Once broken the tank will release a noxious gas into the air around them for a time. It is very difficult to breath causing coughing and damage to the lungs. It will take time for the players lungs to recover. The gas tanks can be found on The Abandoned Factory. The radioactive oxygen tanks can be found on The Waste Pit.

[b]The Generator and Electrified Metal[/b]
The generators have a sensitive safety fuse which can be tripped very easily with something thrown at them. Once they are tripped, all the lights turn off and most metal gets an electric arc that causes it to be electrified. The hum of electric current will be heard whilst it is dangerous and will cause a nasty electric shock and burn if touched. If electrocuted it takes time for the players body to recover. After the safety fuse resets, it will take time for the lights to come back on and for the safety fuse to be able to be disrupted again. The generators can be found on The Industrial Park.

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Yeah I know it is a little late but I have been heads down for so many hours I forgot to do this months update. I [b]HAD[/b] to get it in before the holidays were over and folks thought I had forgotten about them!

For the last month quite a few new changes have come about. Some redesigns have happened. New interactions in the levels. A whole lot of awesomeness for everyone to play with! There have been a couple successful smoke testing and only a couple of bugs found; all have been fixed and updated mind you. And of course preparing for the all new items, new levels, and new mechanics being added for this Update it will feel like a new game!

I wish everyone happy holidays and know that I am working very hard to get this released as soon as possible, but know this, I refuse to put out a update without thoroughly investing testing and bug catching time. I am not perfect, but will do my best to make sure it is the top level quality. That has always been my promise to you and I stand by it.

Now go eat and be merry and enjoy your holidays with family or friends...and if not, please know you have a [url=https://discord.gg/uGdfKjKqZM]community [/url]of The Collar that is always here for you! I appreciate this crazy whirlwind of a year with all of you and that you have chosen to be a part of this [url=https://discord.gg/uGdfKjKqZM]community[/url]. Game on and hope to see you in an experiment!

Happy Holidays and see you all in 2025!!!!

~The Collar is on the naughty list and doesn't care.

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
The leaves are getting crispy, colorful, and falling under our feet. To give away our position.

The cool wind is bringing the chill we all know and love. Or is that death.

Three new levels, a bunch of new mechanics, some surprises, and some new achievements await our next Update together! I have been doing some finishing touches on the new and shining up some of the old with some new improvements both performant and visual. Still more work to be done, but testing time is upon us. Keep watching for announcements...they are coming!

~The Collar hates pumpkin spice.

notes.title: August Update
notes.content:
Well another month has rolled by and lots of work has been completed and more has begun. The second Level, the Parking Garage, has been completed, optimized, and will be playable in the next update. Soon we will have some Alpha Testers playing it to make sure you do not get caught inside a car or fall off the map...cause...well...it happens.

There has been early development in some new items that will help the player and not just used to hit things. Keep an eye out for that in this update too.

As to the current work being done, the third level has been started and laid out. The images are a [b]VERY[/b] early work in progress but gives you a tease what it is. Things are progressing but the details are important and I strive to make the levels great and not just throw assets in it. Keep watching for more updates and keep on enjoying the game!

Do not hesitate to jump into [url=https://discord.gg/uGdfKjKqZM]Discord[/url] and see some updates as they happen and meet some other players! Maybe find a gem to join and make some new friends.

~The Collar is digging deep.

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Ok I admit I am bad at doing updates on a regular basis, but I am trying to do better. Wanted to let everyone know I have been working VERY hard on some really great level additions for the next update. They are coming along very well and I hope we will all get some time in them very soon. I have a small, medium, and large level coming to help continued variety and game play. There is a few new mechanics in this update coming as well, some bug fixes, and some really great optimizations to performance and game play. Even more are some foundations for coming enhancements that are on the roadmap. The game is not stagnant or lost, just only have so much time to balance everything. Maybe I need a staff? 🤣 Hope all is well and you are continuing to have fun with the game. New things are on the horizon even past this update. I truly appreciate the community and the amount of fun that everyone is having and even more to come! And as long as you want more, I will be honored to give you more.

~The Collar is evolving...

notes.title: The Collar Release Date
notes.content:
[h1]Release Date Announcement[/h1]

EXCITING, GREAT, and AWESOME news!!!!! This has been 3 years in the making and it is finally here. On February 29th The Collar will be officially released and the hoards (LOL) of people will begin to play! It is exciting and terrifying all at the same time. Thank you everyone for your support, whether morale or actual game testing, I appreciate each and everyone of you for your help. It could not have been done without you. And our journey does not stop at release...oh no. Once the game is released, I can start planning on the next updates. Keep your eyes open for some new features for the release; got to have something new for those who played test builds!!!!

~The Collar is coming February 29, 2024.
